title: Baked Pumpkin Seeds
nutrition_tip: This baked pumpkin seeds recipe, coats the seeds in a mixture of oil and ranch d…

ingredients.name: 2 cups raw pumpkin seeds, or to taste

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
Toss pumpkin seeds, oil, and ranch dressing mix together in a bowl until evenly coated; spread onto a baking sheet.
Bake in the preheated oven until seeds are lightly browned, about 10 minutes.
